The '''S-K system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Space]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].

==Behind the scenes==
''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' refers to [[Thearterra/Legends|Thearterra]] as "an obscure body in the S-K system", which are the exact words used by General Klytus to describe Earth to Ming the Merciless in the opening scenes of the 1980 film ''[http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flash_Gordon_%28film%29 Flash Gordon]''.
